summary: Assess battery storage sizing, safety, warranties and dispatch. Practise utility and commercial project cases. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Battery storage project development training helps planners and engineers assess and structure projects. Utility planners, engineers, developers and infrastructure finance professionals practise sizing systems against load and grid requirements, comparing technologies, testing dispatch assumptions, reviewing warranties, identifying safety risks, and planning operations and end-of-life decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for assessing, developing, financing, regulating or operating battery storage assets in utility-scale and commercial-and-industrial settings.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with power systems, energy project development or commercial energy management is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use project assumptions, spreadsheets and introductory NREL SAM scenario work.
